setup.adb_done_note: When ADB is on, this page notices and connects by itself. The arrows and OK on the Remote tab still work meanwhile.
setup.wireless_steps: On the TV: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.
setup.enter_port: Enter the connect port (the number after the : ).
setup.enter_addr_code: Enter IP:port and the 6-digit code shown on the TV.
setup.need_port: Paired. Enter the connect port (on the Wireless debugging screen, under “IP address & port”) and press Pair again.
setup.steps_title: Turn on ADB debugging on the TV
setup.steps_use_keys: Use the arrows and OK on the Remote tab, or the TV’s remote:
setup.adb_steps:
1. In Settings: Device Preferences (or System) → About → press OK 7 times on “Build”. Chromecast with Google TV: System → About → press OK 7 times on “Android TV OS build”.
2. Go back, open (System →) Developer options → turn on “USB debugging” (or “ADB debugging”).
3. On the TV tick “Always allow” and choose OK.

If the TV asks for an “ADB password” after the 7 presses: use the “Automatic: install TV Setup on the TV” way.
setup.tcl_hidden_adb: TCL (China) with no Developer options: in Settings → About (Local info), press Up, Down, Left, Right on the remote, round after round, until an ADB window appears. The switch hides again afterwards, so repeat it whenever you need it.
setup.tcl_hidden_adb_short: TCL China (no such menu): on About press Up, Down, Left, Right, round after round; needed again each time.
setup.look_title: The TV does not open Settings on command
setup.look_body:
Look on the TV’s home screen, using the arrows on the Remote tab: the profile/account icon or the gear (usually in a top corner) → Settings → “Device settings”.

FPT Play box: open the Manage panel (profile) → Settings → Device settings.
setup.trying_settings: Trying to open Settings on the TV...
setup.settings_opened_q: Did the TV open its Settings screen?
setup.via_other_home: Open Settings through another home screen
setup.installed_open_else_play: Opens it if installed, otherwise its Google Play page.
setup.home_look_body:
Look at the TV.

• Google Play page: choose Install, then press “Reopen” below.
• Google Play says it is not compatible or not found: press “Choose another”.
• New home screen: find the gear icon → Android settings, then press “Steps to turn on ADB”.

Google Play needs the TV to be signed in to a Google account.
setup.direct_title: Send the install link to the TV
setup.sending_link: Sending the download link to the TV...
setup.direct_body:
Look at the TV: if it asks to download tv-setup.apk, choose OK, then choose Install. When it is installed press “Installed”.

This way is not reliable: some TVs only download without installing, or stop on a white page. Then press “Other way”.
setup.tv_failed_title: The TV could not install it?
setup.tv_failed_body: Many TVs do not install a file downloaded by the browser. Installing through the Downloader app is surer: this page opens Downloader (installs it from Google Play if missing) and has it download TV Setup.
setup.dl_tip: Install TV Setup by hand: on the TV install the Downloader app from Google Play, open it, type the code {code} and press Go. TV Setup opens the place to turn on ADB debugging by itself.
setup.dont_press: Do not press the TV’s remote until it is done.
setup.install_setup_title: Install TV Setup on the TV
setup.moved: The TV screen changed midway: did someone press the TV’s remote? Leave the remote alone and try again.
setup.look_body_tv:
The TV received the link and is downloading TV Setup.

1. The TV asks to install: choose Install. If it asks permission to install from this source: allow it for the downloading app, press Back, then choose Install.
2. When installed choose Open (or press “Open TV Setup” below).
3. TV Setup opens Developer options by itself: turn on “USB debugging”.
4. The TV asks to allow debugging: tick “Always allow”, choose OK. This page connects by itself.
setup.ts_pitch: This page installs Tailscale on the TV; you only need to press “Connect”.
setup.ts_start: Turning on Tailscale on the TV...
setup.ts_closable: You can close this: the TV keeps going.
setup.tv_lost: lost the connection to the TV
setup.ts_qr_tip: Scan with a phone signed in to Tailscale. The TV shows this same code.
setup.ts_step1_tip: No account yet? Make one for free with Google, Microsoft or GitHub.
setup.ts_step2_tip: Tailscale asks whether to add this TV to your account.
setup.ts_waiting: Waiting for the TV to join Tailscale...
setup.ts_save_note: Press “Save” in the last step to use this IP when you are away from home too.
setup.ts_away_note: Away from home: turn on Tailscale on this device (same account), then open the TV by this IP.
setup.ts_expiry_tip: Worth doing: in the Tailscale admin page open the TV’s ⋯ menu → Disable key expiry, so the TV is not signed out after about 180 days.
setup.ts_expiry: 💡 Turn off “key expiry” for the TV so it is not signed out after 180 days.
setup.ts_state_joined: Joined Tailscale · IP {ip}. Away from home, turn on Tailscale on the controlling device (same account) and use this IP.
setup.ts_state_installed: Tailscale is installed but not signed in, or off. Press the button below to turn it on and sign in.
setup.ts_btn_on: ⚡ Turn on and sign in to Tailscale

setup.allowed_by_tv: The TV has allowed this device.
setup.tv_waiting_allow: The TV is waiting for you to allow
setup.tv_waiting_allow_note: Look at the TV: tick “Always allow from this computer” and choose OK.
setup.turn_on_adb_title: Turn on “ADB debugging” on the TV
setup.turn_on_adb_note: Press “Turn ADB on for me” and this page does most of it. Or do it on the TV: Settings → Device Preferences (Google TV, Chromecast: System) → About → press OK 7 times on “Build” (“Android TV OS build”), then back in the same list, Developer options → turn on “ADB debugging” (or “USB debugging”).

setup.ts_ip_note: The TV’s Tailscale IP: {ip}. Worth doing: in the Tailscale admin page open the TV’s ⋯ menu → Disable key expiry, so the TV is not signed out after about 180 days.

tvset.dns_own_ask: Your own DNS server, e.g. dns.google or 8.8.8.8
tvset.dns_turned_off: ⚠️ The TV turned the DNS filter {host} off by itself at {time} on {date}, because with it the TV could not look up any domain (YouTube and other apps report no network). Common on TVs with a VPN such as Tailscale. Choose a filter again to retry.
tvset.size_set: Interface size: {label}. Apps that are open need reopening to follow.
tvset.size_note: Makes text and pictures on the TV bigger or smaller. Normal is the TV’s own size.
tvset.home_one: The TV has only one home screen. Install TV Home or another launcher from the launcher gallery for another choice.
tvset.home_many: The screen shown when you press Home.

tvset.dns_trying: The TV is trying {host}, up to 30 seconds...
tvset.dns_failed: This DNS does not work on the TV’s network; the old setting was kept.
tvset.restart_ask: Restart the TV? It takes about 1–2 minutes; the page reconnects by itself when the TV is back.
tvset.slow_tv: {clock} · The TV still does not answer. If the TV is on its home screen: open the TV Setup app on the TV.
tvset.slow_adb: {clock} · The TV has not turned ADB back on. If the TV is on its home screen: go to Settings → Developer options and turn “ADB debugging” on again.

errors.downloaded_update_does_not: The downloaded update does not match the project's signature, so it was deleted, not installed. Try again later.
errors.pairing_code_wrong_has: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Read the new code on the TV and type it again.
errors.not_pairing_port_use: That is not the pairing port. Use the IP address and port from the TV's "Pair device" box.
errors.tv_not_paired_with: The TV is not paired with this app yet. Pair through Wireless debugging first.
errors.app_cannot_pair_through: This app cannot pair through Wireless debugging on this device.
errors.could_not_open_secure: Could not open a secure connection. Is the TV's date and time right? (Settings → System → Date & time)
errors.vpn_so_tv_at: A VPN is on, so the TV at home is out of reach. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? If so, allow the local network in the VPN app (Local network / Bypass LAN), or turn the VPN off.
errors.tv_asks_allow_usb: The TV asks “Allow USB debugging?”: look at the TV, choose “Always allow”.
errors.still_connecting_tv_over: Still connecting to the TV over ADB. Try again in a moment.
errors.tv_cannot_reach_internet: The TV cannot reach the Internet.
errors.network_slow_dropped_try: The network is slow or dropped. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.tv_stopped_answering_midway: The TV stopped answering midway. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the TV.
errors.file_did_not_reach: The file did not reach the TV whole. Try again.
errors.could_not_read_sign: Could not read the sign-in link off the TV's screen. Open Tailscale on the TV and scan the QR code it shows.
errors.tv_has_no_app: The TV has no app for this kind of file (install VLC, then retry).
errors.tv_out_storage: The TV is out of storage.
errors.apk_needs_android_newer: This APK needs Android {need} or newer; the TV runs Android {have}. Look for an older version of the app.
errors.apk_built_chips_tv: This APK is built for {apk} chips; the TV uses {tv}. Get the build for the right chip (usually armeabi-v7a for TVs).
errors.tv_said_installed_app: The TV said it installed the app, then removed it at once (operator boxes block some apps).
errors.install_blocked: This TV’s firmware blocks installing apps from a computer or phone (both ways were tried). Install it from the TV’s own app store or a USB stick.
errors.tv_has_app_from: The TV has this app from another source (another signature). Remove it, then install again.
errors.tv_has_newer_version: The TV has a newer version of this app.
errors.file_not_apk: This file is not an APK.
errors.roku_blocks_control_from: The Roku blocks control from phones and computers. On the Roku: Settings → System → Advanced system settings → Control by mobile apps → choose Enabled (or Permissive).
errors.hisense_tv_needs_certificate: This Hisense TV needs the certificate from Hisense’s “VIDAA Smart TV” app. Install that app once (no need to open it), then try again.
errors.tv_needs_app_cannot: The TV needs this app; it cannot be removed.
errors.factory_app: A factory test app: opening it can lock the TV in factory mode (no Input key, no HDMI-CEC), so it is not opened.
core.fr_vpn_blocked: A VPN is on, so the TV at home is out of reach. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? If so, allow the local network in the VPN app (Local network / Bypass LAN), or turn the VPN off.
core.fr_notify_no_overlay: This TV does not let apps show a notification over its screen.
core.fr_no_search: This TV has neither YouTube nor Google search to look this up.
core.fr_vidaa_cert_needed: This Hisense TV needs the certificate from Hisense’s “VIDAA Smart TV” app. On the Setup tab, pick that app’s .apk.
core.fr_vidaa_no_cert: No certificate in this file. Pick the .apk of the “VIDAA Smart TV” app, or a .p12 file.
core.fr_volume_locked: This TV keeps that volume itself and will not let it be changed remotely. Movie and music volume can be.
core.fr_turned_back_off: The TV turned it straight back off. Wireless debugging only works while the TV is on Wi‑Fi (not a network cable).
core.fr_roku_blocked: The Roku blocks control from phones and computers. On the Roku: Settings → System → Advanced system settings → Control by mobile apps → choose Enabled (or Permissive).
core.fr_tv_refused: The TV said no. Press Ask the TV again on the Setup tab, then choose Allow.
core.fr_not_accepted: Nobody chose Allow on the TV. Press Ask the TV again on the Setup tab.
core.fr_secure_failed: Could not open a secure connection. Is the TV's date and time right? (Settings → System → Date & time)
core.fr_no_internet: The TV (or this device) cannot reach the Internet.
core.fr_net_slow: The network is slow or dropped. Try again in a few minutes.
core.fr_tv_stopped: The TV stopped answering midway. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the TV.
core.fr_copy_incomplete: The file did not reach the TV whole. Try again.
core.fr_connection_lost: Lost the TV halfway. Try again.
core.fr_no_signin_link: Could not read the sign-in link off the TV's screen. Open Tailscale on the TV and scan the QR code it shows.
core.fr_no_space: The TV is out of storage.
core.fr_no_viewer_app: The TV has no app for this kind of file (install VLC, then retry).
core.fr_no_launcher: This app has no screen to open: it only runs in the background, or is part of another app.
core.fr_pair_wrong_code: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Read the new code on the TV and type it again.
core.fr_pair_wrong_port: That is not the pairing port. Use the IP address and port from the TV’s “Pair device” box.
core.fr_not_paired: The TV is not paired with this app yet. Pair through Wireless debugging first.
core.fr_cannot_pair: This app cannot pair through Wireless debugging on this device.
core.fr_not_backup: This file is not a TV Remote backup.
core.fr_protected_app: The TV needs this app: it cannot be disabled or cleared.
core.fr_removed_after_install: The TV said it installed the app, then removed it right away. Operator boxes (FPT Play...) block some apps; this one cannot be used on this TV.
core.fr_install_blocked: This TV’s firmware blocks installing apps from a computer or phone (both ways were tried). Install it from the TV’s own app store or a USB stick.
core.fr_perm_fixed: The TV does not let this permission change: the system keeps it.
core.fr_perm_not_asked: This app does not ask for that permission.
core.fr_signature_differs: The TV already has this app from another source (a different signature). Uninstall it first, then install again; the app’s data will be lost.
core.fr_newer_installed: The TV has a newer version of this app. Uninstall it first to install an older one.
core.fr_older_sdk: This APK needs a newer Android than the TV has. Look for an older version of the app.
core.fr_setup_latest: TV Setup on the TV is already the latest version.
core.fr_setup_updating: TV Setup is updating itself. Wait about a minute.
core.fr_setup_missing: The TV does not have the TV Setup app.
core.fr_update_not_started: The TV did not start the update. Try again; if it still does not, restart the TV.
core.fr_update_script_failed: Could not write the update file on the TV. Does it have free storage?
core.fr_abi_mismatch: This APK is for a different kind of chip than the TV’s. Get the build for the right chip (usually armeabi-v7a).
core.fr_storage_apk: The TV has only {free} free, not enough to install this {size} APK (it needs at least {need}: the copy and the installed app). Remove some apps or files (Health / Files tab), then try again.
core.fr_storage_file: The TV has only {free} free, not enough for this {size} file (it needs at least {need}). Remove some apps or files (Health / Files tab), then try again.
core.fr_sdk_low: This APK needs Android {need} or newer; the TV runs Android {have}. Look for an older version of the app (APKMirror lists “Min: Android ...”).
core.fr_abi_other: This APK is for {apk} chips, the TV uses {tv}. Get the build for the right chip (usually armeabi-v7a on TVs).
diagnose_kt.tv_s_date_time: The TV's date and time are wrong

diagnose_kt.device_another_network_than: This device is on another network than the TV
diagnose_kt.tv_at_join_tv: The TV is at {ip}. Join the TV's own Wi-Fi (not a guest network or mobile data), then try again.
diagnose_kt.tailscale_off_device: Tailscale is off on this device
diagnose_kt.tv_at_tailscale_address: The TV is at the Tailscale address {ip}. Turn Tailscale on here, then try again.
diagnose_kt.look_at_tv_tick: Look at the TV: tick “Always allow” in the “Allow USB debugging?” box, then choose OK.
diagnose_kt.adb_debugging_off_tv: ADB debugging is off on the TV
diagnose_kt.wireless_only: This TV only has Wireless debugging

diagnose_kt.keys_still_work_picture: The keys still work. For the picture, apps and files turn on “ADB debugging” in the TV's Developer options.
diagnose_kt.tv_s_remote_service: The TV's remote service does not answer
diagnose_kt.adb_answers_so_keys: ADB answers, so keys go through ADB. To use the remote without ADB, restart the TV.
diagnose_kt.error_was_momentary_try: The error was momentary. Try again; if the TV shows a question, choose Allow.
diagnose_kt.tv_network_but_not: The TV is on the network but not listening
diagnose_kt.usually_tv_dozing_press: Usually the TV is dozing. Press the power button on the TV's own remote, wait a few seconds, then try again.
diagnose_kt.found_at_was_use: Found “{name}” at {ip} (it was {was}). Use the new address?
diagnose_kt.vpn_way: A VPN is in the way
diagnose_kt.tv_at_home_out: The TV at home is out of reach while the VPN is on. Allow the local network in the VPN app (Local network / Bypass LAN), or turn the VPN off, then try again.
diagnose_kt.tv_may_be_off: The TV may be off or asleep, or have a new address. Turn it on and try again, or scan the network to find it.
diagnose_kt.device_s_network_nothing: This device's network: nothing to check
diagnose_kt.device_tv_s_network: This device is on the TV's network
diagnose_kt.device_another_network_than_: This device is on another network than the TV
diagnose_kt.tv_network_but_its: The TV is on the network but its ports are closed

picker.1_turn_on_adb:
1. TURN ON ADB ON THE TV (once)
Settings → Device Preferences (Google TV, Chromecast: System) → About → press OK 7 times on “Build” (“Android TV OS build”). Then back in the same list, Developer options → turn on “ADB debugging”.

2A. SAME WI-FI AS THE TV
Tap “Scan the Wi-Fi” and pick the TV. Or read the IP on the TV: Settings → Network & Internet → the Wi-Fi name.

2B. ANOTHER NETWORK
Turn on Tailscale on both the phone and the TV. Once the TV has been connected at home, the app remembers its Tailscale IP: away, just tap the TV in the list. Otherwise type the TV’s 100.x IP (see the Tailscale app).

No Tailscale on the TV yet? While at home, connect to the TV, then tap the grid button → Setup → “Install and sign in to Tailscale”: the app installs it on the TV and opens the sign-in page on the phone; you only press Connect.

3. THE FIRST CONNECTION
The TV asks for permission: tick “Always allow”, then OK.

TIPS
The power button next to a TV wakes it when it is off. The ✕ next to a TV removes it from the list.

priv.note: Which apps on the TV could listen, watch or track. It only says what was seen, not that an app is spying.

priv.sum_acr.other: {n} apps recognise what is on screen

priv.own_note: They hold these for their own work: accessibility so the remote's buttons still work with the screen off or another launcher, drawing over apps for the notice and the drawing, app history for the time limits, location for TV Home's weather. Nothing is sent anywhere.
priv.a11y_off_tip: The app no longer reads the screen; it stays on the TV. Turn it back on in the TV's Settings.

priv.h_acr: On the list of apps that recognise what is on screen for measurement
priv.h_track: On the list of usage-collecting apps
priv.h_ads: On the list of ad apps
priv.h_admin: A device admin: it can lock or wipe the TV
priv.h_overlay: Allowed to draw over other apps
priv.h_usage: Can see which apps you open and when
priv.h_assist: The default assistant or speech recognition service
priv.h_phone: Allowed to read phone state, call log or messages
priv.h_nearby: Allowed to scan for nearby Bluetooth / Wi-Fi devices
priv.ev_mic_now: Was using the microphone during the check
priv.ev_mic_idle: Holds the microphone, not seen using it
priv.ev_cam_now: Was using the camera during the check
priv.ev_cam_idle: Holds the camera, not seen using it
priv.ev_loc_now: Was getting the location during the check
priv.ev_loc_idle: Holds the location, not seen using it
priv.ev_a11y: Accessibility is on: it can read the screen
priv.ev_assist: Is the default assistant / speech recognition
priv.revoke_tip: Takes back its microphone, camera, location... You can give them back. The app may restart.

priv.keep: The TV needs this app, so it stays as is
